name: skraft-backlog
description: skraft backlog — discover and triage GitHub issues, refine them into ready stories, and review each issue's refinement in a comment, from your editor or a GitHub Agentic Workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Triage GitHub issues, refine them into ready stories, review a refinement in a comment.
interface.longDescription: skraft-backlog surfaces the GitHub issues worth working on, classifies them, and refines them into stories that clear the Definition of Ready: a specific persona, real domain examples, Given/When/Then acceptance criteria and a Fibonacci size. Each producer runs an independent lens review whose verdict a script computes. The same refinement can run in a GitHub Agentic Workflow that comments its proposal on new issues.
defaultPrompt: Triage the open issues assigned to me.
Refine issue #42 into a ready story.
